scope: Only the exact sampled_target_ids from the v3 audit are enumerated (not all eligible or raw objects).
Original eight vertices are used; none of these counts are filtered by visibility.
The prior audit did not persist per-view visible target IDs. No visibility was recomputed.
Counts are unordered distinct instance pairs/triples, not questions, images, trajectories or multi-view-valid cases.
Near-collinear and near-right-angle are world XY configurations of object centers; neither proves semantic object fronts or viewpoint transformation ambiguity.
Five-object relative-distance benchmark filtering is not implemented.
